text: 潘功胜回应“信贷失速”焦虑：金融支持实体不能只看贷款增速 中国融资结构已从间接融资主导，转向直接融资与间接融资协调发展。
text_en: Pan Gongsheng responds to "credit slowdown" anxiety: financial support for the real economy can't be judged by loan growth alone; China's financing structure has shifted from being dominated by indirect financing to coordinated development of direct and indirect financing.
